description: This file defines Express routes for authentication-related endpoints, including login with email/password and social login, utilizing JWT tokens for authentication.

methods.name: router.post('/login')
methods.description: Handles user login via email and password, verifies credentials, and returns a JWT token with user info.

methods.name: router.post('/social')
methods.description: Handles social login, mocks verification, and issues a JWT token with user info.
